parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh-CN**: Chinese.

- **en-US** (default): English.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique among different requests and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description:
The ID of the domain name instance configuration. For the same access domain name and GTM instance, you can configure both A and AAAA records. This results in two domain name instance configurations for the GTM instance. The ConfigId uniquely identifies a specific configuration.

Call the [ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~2797349~~) operation to query the ConfigId of a domain name instance.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description:
The enablement status of the domain name instance. Valid values:

- enable: Enables the domain name instance.

- disable: Disables the domain name instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM 3.0 instance that you want to modify.
